meta.title: Slipr in Conclusion style
meta.subtitle: Every layout of the Conclusion template
meta.author: Lucas Jellema
meta.description: A tour of the Conclusion (magenta) Slipr template: one slide per layout. The photos are neutral placeholders; real shows use photography from the brand library.

reader.summary: The Conclusion PowerPoint template, rebuilt as a Slipr template.

blocks.md: This show demonstrates every layout of the **Conclusion** template for Slipr. It uses the original logo, footer band and wave artwork from the official PowerPoint template, on the same grid.

blocks.title: Text styles
blocks.md: The body supports the template's text styles: bullets up to four levels, a **bold line as subheading**, *serif italic*, letter lists and numbered lists.

content.title: Text on black
content.body:
The black variant of the standard text slide.

**What it is for**

- Most content slides in the template are dark
- Magenta bullets, white text
  - Up to four levels deep

content.title: Text and image

- A text column on the left
- The photo fills the slide behind it
- A dark gradient keeps the text readable
